game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mystic Forest – Misty Bog, a misty bog: the forest ranger must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Reverse Countdown: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches.
theme: Mystic Forest – Misty Bog: a misty bog
core_gameplay_loop: In Misty Bog, repeat each round: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches. Each round, bog toads strike the seed vault, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the launch_timing value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the seed vault from bog toads in Misty Bog: keep the launch_timing meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 34-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: launch_timing drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 34-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Reverse Countdown
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reverse Countdown' (Week 5 slot 8), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Misty Bog'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how launch_timing changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Misty Bog.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 34 seconds while launch_timing > 0.
